destinations.name: Siargao
destinations.description: A laid-back island paradise famous for world-class waves, coconut groves, and island-hopping lagoons. Perfect for surfers and beach lovers alike.
destinations.whyPopular: Home to the legendary Cloud 9 surf break and some of the country's dreamiest beaches, Siargao blends epic surf with a relaxed tropical lifestyle.
destinations.bestTime: Dry season March to May; surfing season July to November
destinations.howToGetThere: Direct flights to Siargao airport (IAO) from Manila, Cebu and Clark

places.name: Cloud 9
places.description: Siargao's iconic surf break with a boardwalk over the reef, famous for its perfect barreling waves.
places.bestTime: July to November for big swells

places.name: Magpupungko Rock Pools
places.description: Natural tidal pools revealed at low tide, ideal for swimming and cliff jumping into crystal-clear water.

places.name: Sohoton Cove
places.description: A hidden cove on Bucas Grande with emerald lagoons, stingless jellyfish, and towering limestone cliffs.

places.name: Maasin River
places.description: A winding palm-fringed river famous for paddleboarding, rope swings, and the bent coconut tree photo spot.

places.name: Guyam Island
places.description: A tiny postcard-perfect islet with powdery white sand and palm trees, part of the tri-island hopping tour.

places.name: Sugba Lagoon
places.description: A stunning blue lagoon on Kawhagan Island with a diving platform, perfect for kayaking and swimming.

places.name: Surfing Lessons at Cloud 9
places.description: Learn to ride your first wave with a local instructor on the gentle beginner breaks near Cloud 9.

places.name: Tri-Island Hopping Tour
places.description: Boat-hop between Naked, Daku, and Guyam islands in one day, with snorkeling stops and beach picnics.

places.name: Stand-Up Paddleboarding
places.description: Glide along the calm Maasin River or lagoons at sunrise for a peaceful, scenic workout.

places.name: General Luna Nightlife
places.description: Beach bars and live music along Tourism Road keep the island buzzing after the sun goes down.

places.name: Shaka Siargao
places.description: Famous smoothie bowls, acai, and coffee in a tropical garden setting loved by surfers.

places.name: Fat Lips Surf Shack
places.description: Beachfront spot serving burgers, rice bowls, and cold drinks with live reggae vibes.

places.name: Kermit Siargao
places.description: Italian-Filipino fusion pizzas and pastas in a stylish surf-town setting near Cloud 9.

places.name: CEV: Ceviche & Kinilaw Shack
places.description: Fresh kinilaw and ceviche bowls made from the day's catch, right by the beach.

places.name: Siargao Bleu Resort & Spa
places.description: Upscale beachfront resort with villas, a spa, and fine dining near Cloud 9.

places.name: Kalinaw Resort
places.description: Balinese-style boutique resort with lush gardens, a pool, and steps from the beach.

places.name: Isla Villas Siargao
places.description: Comfortable mid-range rooms and suites a short stroll from the main strip.

places.name: General Luna Public Market
places.description: Local market with fresh produce, fish, snacks, and affordable pasalubong finds.

places.name: Tourism Road Souvenir Shops
places.description: Stalls and boutiques along Tourism Road selling surf merch, handmade jewelry, and island crafts.

places.name: Sayak Airport
places.description: The island airport; 45-min van ride to General Luna.

places.name: Dapa Port
places.description: Ferry terminal for Surigao City connections and island-hopping boats.

places.name: General Luna Van Terminal
places.description: Vans to the airport, Dapa port and Maasin River jump-off.

transport.useCase: Short hops around General Luna town
transport.notes: Habal-habal (motorbike taxi) is the more common option for reaching surf spots.

transport.useCase: Trips between towns like Dapa and General Luna
transport.notes: Limited schedules; ask locals for the latest departure times.

transport.useCase: Airport transfers and group island tours
transport.notes: Most hotels and resorts arrange shared van pickups from Siargao airport.

transport.useCase: Best way to explore the island at your own pace
transport.notes: Always wear a helmet; check the scooter's brakes and lights before renting.

transport.useCase: Island-hopping to Naked, Daku, Guyam, and Sohoton Cove
transport.notes: Boats are shared or private; life vests are provided by law.

transport.useCase: Airport transfers on demand
transport.notes: Very limited availability; book through your hotel in advance.

destinations.name: Davao
destinations.tagline: The Crown Jewel of the South
destinations.description: A thriving, clean, and safe city with durian, the Philippine Eagle, and Mount Apo on its doorstep. Great mix of urban comfort and nature.
destinations.whyPopular: Gateway to Mount Apo and the eagle sanctuary, plus a legendary food scene built around durian, tuna, and grilled Filipino barbecue.
destinations.bestTime: Dry season November to April; Kadayawan Festival in August
destinations.howToGetThere: Direct flights to Davao International Airport (DVO) from Manila, Cebu, Clark, and international hubs

places.name: Philippine Eagle Center
places.description: Sanctuary protecting the majestic Philippine Eagle, with guided tours through lush forest enclosures.

places.name: People's Park
places.description: A beloved city park with waterfalls, ponds, sculptures, and a dancing fountain show at night.

places.name: Eden Nature Park
places.description: A mountain resort with gardens, sky rides, fishing village, and cool breezes above the city.

places.name: Mount Apo
places.description: The highest peak in the Philippines at 2,954m, a bucket-list climb for serious trekkers.

places.name: Davao Crocodile Park
places.description: Crocodile farm and wildlife park with feeding shows, tigers, and an exotic animal collection.

places.name: Samal Island
places.description: Island of white-sand beaches and resorts just a short ferry ride from the city waterfront.

places.name: Davao River White-Water Rafting
places.description: Thrilling rapids through tropical jungle just outside the city, with certified river guides.

places.name: Samal Island Beach Day
places.description: Ferry across the bay for a beach day, snorkeling, and resort pools with a city skyline backdrop.

places.name: Durian Tasting Tour
places.description: Brave the king of fruits at Magsaysay Park fruit stalls, where durian is a way of life.

places.name: Roxas Night Market
places.description: Famous night market for grilled tuna, street food stalls, and local snacks under the lights.

places.name: Penong's
places.description: Davao institution for chicken and pork barbecue served on banana leaves with unlimited rice.

places.name: Marina Tuna
places.description: Fresh tuna belly, sashimi, and kinilaw straight from the General Santos fishing grounds.

places.name: Claude's Le Cafe de Ville
places.description: Charming French-style cafe with pastries, cakes, and brewed coffee in the city center.

places.name: Lachi's
places.description: Beloved homestyle Filipino dishes in a cozy setting, from kare-kare to sizzling sisig.

places.name: Marco Polo Davao
places.description: Landmark luxury hotel on Shrine Hills with panoramic city views, pool, and fine dining.

places.name: Park Inn by Radisson Davao
places.description: Modern hotel beside SM Lanang with bright rooms, a rooftop pool, and all-day dining.

places.name: Acacia Hotel Davao
places.description: Comfortable mid-range hotel with spacious rooms near the Davao Convention Center.

places.name: SM City Davao
places.description: Large mall with international brands, cinemas, and plenty of dining options.

places.name: Bankerohan Public Market
places.description: Bustling local market for fresh fruit, durian, seafood, and Davao pasalubong.

places.name: Francisco Bangoy International Airport
places.description: Mindanao gateway; 30-min taxi to downtown.

places.name: Ecoland Bus Terminal
places.description: Buses to the north (Butuan, Surigao), south (Gensan) and Cotabato.

places.name: Sasa Wharf
places.description: Ferries to Samal Island (10 min) — beach day trips made easy.

transport.useCase: Short neighborhood trips
transport.notes: Common in barangays; flag one down or ask your hotel to call one.

transport.useCase: Main city routes across Davao
transport.notes: Extensive network; ask the driver or conductor if it passes your stop.

transport.useCase: Airport transfers and tours to Eagle Center or Eden Park
transport.notes: Tour vans are easy to book through hotels and travel desks.

transport.useCase: Independent exploring within the city
transport.notes: Less common than in beach towns; book from rental shops in advance.

transport.useCase: Ferries and bangkas to Samal Island
transport.notes: Island City Express and resort boats run frequently from Sasa Wharf.

transport.useCase: Comfortable rides anywhere in the metro
transport.notes: Grab is widely available; metered taxis queue at malls and the airport.

destinations.name: Camiguin
destinations.description: A small volcanic island packed with waterfalls, hot springs, and sandbars. Easy to circle in a day, but you'll want to stay longer.
destinations.whyPopular: White Island's powdery sandbar, the haunting Sunken Cemetery cross, and sweet lanzones draw nature lovers from around the world.
destinations.bestTime: Dry season April to June; Lanzones Festival in October
destinations.howToGetThere: Fly to Camiguin (CGM) from Cebu, or ferry from Balingoan (Cagayan de Oro) and Jagna (Bohol)

places.name: White Island
places.description: A shifting white-sand bar off Mambajao with views of Mt. Hibok-Hibok, perfect for sunrise photos.

places.name: Sunken Cemetery
places.description: A giant cross marking a cemetery swallowed by a volcanic eruption, now a famous snorkeling site.

places.name: Katibawasan Falls
places.description: A 250-foot cascade plunging into a cool natural pool, surrounded by giant ferns and orchids.

places.name: Tuasan Falls
places.description: A rugged waterfall reached by a short trek through farmland, with a refreshing swimming pool.

places.name: Ardent Hot Spring
places.description: Naturally heated pools from Mt. Hibok-Hibok, wonderful for a soothing evening soak.

places.name: Mantigue Island
places.description: A marine sanctuary island with white beaches, giant clams, and excellent snorkeling.

places.name: Camiguin Island Loop Tour
places.description: Circle the whole island in a day by habal-habal or van, hitting waterfalls, springs, and viewpoints.

places.name: Snorkeling at Sunken Cemetery
places.description: Snorkel over coral gardens growing on the sunken tombstones, with giant clam sanctuaries nearby.

places.name: Hot Spring Evening Soak
places.description: Unwind in the warm mineral pools of Ardent Hot Spring after a day of island exploring.

places.name: Guiob Church Ruins Visit
places.description: Explore centuries-old church ruins left by the 1871 volcanic eruption, next to the old cemetery.

places.name: The Beehive
places.description: Cozy cafe serving hearty breakfasts, burgers, and fresh juices near the town center.

places.name: Luna Ristorante
places.description: Italian-inspired dishes and Filipino favorites in a garden restaurant in Mambajao.

places.name: Bahay Kubo Restaurant
places.description: Traditional Filipino dishes served in a nipa hut setting, with fresh grilled seafood.

places.name: Guerrera Rice Paddy Villas
places.description: Boutique villas set among rice paddies with views of the volcanoes and the sea.

places.name: Paras Beach Resort
places.description: Classic beachfront resort with cottages, gardens, and easy access to White Island boats.

places.name: Mambajao Public Market
places.description: Local market for fresh fruit, famous lanzones, and handmade souvenirs.

places.name: Mambajao Pasalubong Center
places.description: Shops selling lanzones wine, pastillas, and Camiguin-themed crafts to take home.

places.name: Benoni Port
places.description: Main RORO/fastcraft gateway from Balingoan, Misamis Oriental.

places.name: Balbagon Port
places.description: Fastcrafts to Jagna, Bohol.

transport.useCase: Getting around Mambajao town
transport.notes: Trikes wait near the market and port; agree on the fare first.

transport.useCase: Routes between the five towns
transport.notes: Multicabs and jeepneys connect Mambajao, Catarman, Sagay, Guinsiliban, and Mahinog.

transport.useCase: Day tours circling the island
transport.notes: Private van tours are the easiest way to hit all the highlights in one day.

transport.useCase: DIY island loop at your own pace
transport.notes: The 64km circumferential road is well-paved and perfect for scooters.

transport.useCase: Trips to White Island and Mantigue Island
transport.notes: Book through your resort or the tourism office; wear reef-safe sunscreen.

transport.useCase: Airport or port transfers
transport.notes: Very limited; most travelers use tricycles or hotel shuttles instead.

destinations.name: Cagayan de Oro
destinations.description: Northern Mindanao's adventure hub, famous for white-water rafting on the Cagayan River and some of the friendliest locals in the Philippines.
destinations.whyPopular: The white-water rafting capital of the country, with caves, nature parks, and day-trip access to Dahilayan's ziplines.
destinations.bestTime: Dry season December to May; adventure tours run year-round
destinations.howToGetThere: Direct flights to Laguindingan Airport (CGY) from Manila, Cebu, Clark, and Davao

places.name: Mapawa Nature Park
places.description: A riverside nature park with waterfalls, natural pools, and cliff-jumping spots in a scenic gorge.

places.name: Gaston Park & St. Augustine Cathedral
places.description: Historic plaza and cathedral at the heart of the city, perfect for an evening stroll.

places.name: Macahambus Hill Cave
places.description: A short trek leads to a cave gorge with a hanging bridge and WWII historical markers.

places.name: Seven Seas Waterpark
places.description: The country's largest pirate-themed waterpark with slides, a lazy river, and wave pools.

places.name: Divine Mercy Shrine
places.description: A 50-foot statue of the Divine Mercy overlooking Macajalar Bay, a popular pilgrimage site.

places.name: Cagayan River White-Water Rafting
places.description: The country's top rafting run, with beginner-friendly and extreme sections through jungle canyons.

places.name: Dahilayan Adventure Park Day Trip
places.description: Ride one of Asia's longest ziplines and cool pine-forest trails, an hour from the city.

places.name: Lifestyle District Nightlife
places.description: Bars, live bands, and late-night eats in the city's entertainment district.

places.name: Lechon Food Crawl
places.description: Taste the city's beloved roasted pork and local delicacies on a guided food crawl.

places.name: Kagay-on's
places.description: Classic Filipino buffet and grilled dishes in a spacious native-style dining hall.

places.name: Boy Zugba
places.description: Fun, colorful spot for affordable Filipino comfort food with a playful local vibe.

places.name: Missy Bon Bon
places.description: Beloved CDO bakeshop and cafe famous for cakes, pastries, and rich chocolate drinks.

places.name: Bigby's Cafe & Restaurant
places.description: A Mindanao-born chain serving hearty Filipino-Western plates loved by locals.

places.name: Limketkai Luxe Hotel
places.description: Upscale hotel beside Limketkai Center with a rooftop pool and skyline views.

places.name: Seda Centrio
places.description: Sleek business hotel above Ayala Centrio Mall with a rooftop bar and pool.

places.name: Mallberry Suites Business Hotel
places.description: Comfortable mid-range suites near the business district, great value for families.

places.name: SM CDO Downtown
places.description: Central mall with fashion brands, electronics, cinemas, and dining terraces.

places.name: Cogon Public Market
places.description: The city's main public market for fresh produce, seafood, and affordable local goods.

places.name: Laguindingan Airport
places.description: Airport serving CDO and Iligan; 45-min shuttle to the city.

places.name: Agora Bus Terminal
places.description: Buses to Davao, Butuan, Bukidnon and Iligan.

places.name: Macabalan Port
places.description: Ferries to Cebu, Bohol and Camiguin.

transport.useCase: Short trips within neighborhoods
transport.notes: Easy to hail on side streets; agree on the fare before riding.

transport.useCase: Main routes across the city
transport.notes: Look for route signs on the windshield; multicabs serve shorter hops.

transport.useCase: Tours to Mapawa, Macahambus, and Dahilayan
transport.notes: Most adventure operators include van transfers in their packages.

transport.useCase: Flexible exploring around the metro
transport.notes: Check the rental's condition and always wear a helmet.

transport.useCase: Ferries to Camiguin via Balingoan port
transport.notes: Take a bus or van to Balingoan port, then the ferry to Benoni.

transport.useCase: Airport runs and comfortable city rides
transport.notes: Grab is available; metered taxis queue at malls and Laguindingan airport.

destinations.name: Zamboanga
destinations.description: A historic coastal city where Spanish-era forts meet pink-sand beaches and vibrant Chavacano culture. Off the beaten path and full of surprises.
destinations.whyPopular: The famous pink sand of Santa Cruz Island, colorful vintas, and a unique blend of cultures make it unlike anywhere else in the country.
destinations.bestTime: Dry season December to May; Hermosa Festival in October
destinations.howToGetThere: Direct flights to Zamboanga International Airport (ZAM) from Manila, Cebu, and Davao

places.name: Great Santa Cruz Island
places.description: One of the world's rare pink-sand beaches, with coral gardens and mangrove lagoons.

places.name: Fort Pilar
places.description: A 17th-century Spanish fort housing a shrine and museum, the city's most iconic landmark.

places.name: Paseo del Mar
places.description: A scenic waterfront promenade perfect for sunset walks, street food, and sea views.

places.name: Merloquet Falls
places.description: A two-tiered waterfall with a natural infinity pool, hidden in the hills east of the city.
places.bestTime: Morning, rainy season for full flow

places.name: Yakan Weaving Village
places.description: Watch Yakan weavers create intricate traditional textiles and shop authentic handmade crafts.

places.name: Pink Beach Day Trip
places.description: Boat to Great Santa Cruz Island for pink sand, snorkeling, and a seafood lunch by the shore.

places.name: Yakan Weaving Workshop
places.description: Try your hand at the Yakan backstrap loom and learn the stories behind each pattern.

places.name: Merloquet Falls Trek
places.description: Trek through forest trails to the falls' infinity pool for a swim above the canopy.

places.name: Sunset at Paseo del Mar
places.description: Grab grilled snacks from the stalls and watch the sun sink over the Sulu Sea.

places.name: Alavar Seafood Restaurant
places.description: Zamboanga institution famous for curacha crabs in coconut milk and fresh seafood platters.

places.name: Dennis Coffee Garden
places.description: Garden cafe serving native coffee, fresh buko juice, and classic Filipino snacks.

places.name: Jimmy's Satti House
places.description: Local favorite for satti, Zamboanga's spicy Tausug-style grilled skewers with rice sauce.

places.name: Garden Orchid Hotel
places.description: The city's premier hotel with gardens, pools, and restaurants near the waterfront.

places.name: Marcian Hotel
places.description: Modern business hotel with comfortable rooms and a rooftop pool in the city center.

places.name: LM Metro Hotel
places.description: Budget-friendly hotel with clean, spacious rooms close to shopping areas.

places.name: SM City Mindpro
places.description: The city's main mall with local and national brands, plus a supermarket and cinemas.

places.name: Canelar Public Market
places.description: Lively market for seafood, seaweed delicacies, and Yakan woven souvenirs.

places.name: Zamboanga International Airport
places.description: Gateway to the Zamboanga Peninsula; 15 min to downtown.

places.name: Zamboanga Port
places.description: Ferries to Basilan, Jolo and Sandakan, Malaysia.

places.name: Zamboanga Bus Terminal
places.description: Buses to Pagadian, Dipolog and Ipil.

transport.useCase: Getting around the city center
transport.notes: Plentiful downtown; agree on the fare before the trip.

transport.useCase: Routes across the city and nearby towns
transport.notes: Routes cover most barangays; ask locals for the right jeepney sign.

transport.useCase: Airport transfers and tours to Merloquet Falls
transport.notes: Tour vans are best booked through hotels or travel agencies.

transport.useCase: Independent day trips
transport.notes: Limited rental shops; book in advance through your hotel.

transport.useCase: Trips to Great Santa Cruz Island
transport.notes: Book at the Paseo del Mar tourism desk; permits and guides are required.

transport.useCase: Airport runs and longer city rides
transport.notes: Metered taxis are common; ride-hailing apps have limited coverage.
